# ControlMesh

CM runs an explicitly supplied command, checks its real result, and writes a bounded execution report. The current host Agent owns task choice, authorization, repair and delivery. Each CLI keeps its native tools, model, login and session.

## Read progressively

- [Project intent](PROJECT.md)
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md)
- [Run and verify](docs/run.md)
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Decisions](docs/DECISIONS.md)
- [Current acceptance](plans/cm-usable-orchestration-20261124/progress.md)

## Optional capabilities

- [CLI child tasks](docs/agent-link-subagents.md)
- [SpecMesh handoff](docs/workflows/small-change.md)
- [Committed-state synchronization](docs/closeout.md)
- [Codex completion callback](docs/codex-callback.md)

Memory belongs to [AgentTraceMesh's optional plugin](https://github.com/qiaoqiao2521/AgentTraceMesh/blob/main/docs/memory-plugin.md). CM does not own memory storage, recall, injection or receipt forwarding.

`cm run` does not automatically pass the task file to the worker, retry commands, choose a model, or start a background scheduler. An artifact list is not a sandbox. A success report covers only the explicitly executed checks.

Paperclip / Orca integrations and the old Python / TypeScript runtime have been retired from the current repository. This does not change running servers or delete private state. Historical implementations are available at [baseline 851d78b](https://github.com/qiaoqiao2521/ControlMesh/tree/851d78b8989d07281d0082a5105f878a99f589c8).
